title: Hadrian model band
description: A full-bleed media band under a dark veil: a gold mono label, a large tight grotesk heading, then three offers in a row, each a big title over a white rule with a short paragraph below (stacked on phones, filling the window).
notes: always dark: the band is a .dark scope, so its text stays light over the veil in light themes too
the veil is the page colour at 60%; over a real video it tints toward the theme's navy
at least one window tall on phones, content height from 1024px
